Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all from this game. Bangladesh have etched a famous win in their T20I history to take the lead in this three-match series. Mitchell Santer and New Zealand will have to go back to the drawing board and come up with answers if they are to keep the series alive. The second T20I will take place on Friday, December 29 at Bay Oval in Mount Maunganui. The game will begin at 11.40 am IST (6.10 am GMT) but our build-up will begin much sooner. Until then, take care and goodye!
Mahedi Hasan is the Player of the Match for his all-round brilliance where he took 2 for 14 from his four overs and played a unbeaten cameo of 19 runs from 16 balls.
Time for the presentation ceremony....

Earlier in the game, after being inserted into bat, New Zealand were off to a rocky start, losing their first three wickets in the first 9 balls. Daryl Mitchell began to rebuild the innings along with Mark Chapman but neither of them was able to carry on. James Neesham then led the fightback and took calculated risks to keep the scoreboard ticking. He found an able alley in Mitchell Santner but the latter failed to kick on. Neesham followed suit and his departure came at the most inopportune time for New Zealand. Thanks to contributions from the lower order, the Kiwis limped their way to 134. Shoriful Islam was the star of Bangladesh's show with figures of 3 for 26 from his four overs. Mahedi Hasan and Mustafizur Rahman accounted for two wickets each while Tanzim Hasan Sakib and Rishad Hossain took one wicket apiece.

With not a big total to defend, New Zealand needed early breakthroughs to put Bangladesh under pressure. Rony Talukdar came out all guns blazing but Adam Milne was able to nip him in the bud before he could do any more damage. However, the Kiwi pacers were unable to capitalise on that early scalp and allowed the Tigers to build partnerships during the middle phase. James Neesham struck gold for New Zealand with the wicket of Najmul Hossain Shanto before Ben Sears got himself into the wicket-taking act. They were then stalled by the gritty stand between Litton Das and Towhid Hridoy and defensive fields meant that the pair were able to bat freely without any pressure of dots. Mitchell Santner broke that stand and Tim Southee backed it up with a wicket to give New Zealand a glimmer of hope. However, the Kiwis were not able to mount the pressure as they would have liked and the low total meant they ended up on the losing side.

In pursuit of 135, Rony Talukdar made his intentions clear right away for Bangladesh as he looked to smack just about every ball. However, the same approach soon led to his downfall. Najmul Hossain Shanto continued where he left off in the third ODI and put the pressure back on New Zealand. Shanto was dismissed while looking good as did Soumya Sarkar before he got out on 22. Litton Das and Towhid Hridoy then got together and used their smarts to bat sensibly in the middle phase by taking the ones and twos. Hridoy ran out of patience and Afif Hossain could not do much either which gave New Zealand a sniff. However, Litton Das held the innings together and brought his years of experience into play to bat though and take his side over the line. He remained unbeaten on 42 while Mahedi Hasan provided the finishing touches with an unbeaten 19-run knock.

Bangladesh are on a history-creating spree in New Zealand, aren't they? First, the historic win in the third ODI, and they have now backed up that performance with their first-ever T20 win against New Zealand in New Zealand. There were a few nervy moments in the chase for the Tigers but they got over the line comfortably in the end to go 1-0 up in the series. On the other hand, New Zealand have been outbowled by Bangladesh in two consecutive games across formats and the Kiwis have lots to ponder on.

Commentary.Commentary: Fullish length, around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pats it off the front foot to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Adam Milne to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller this time and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto drives well but picks out the man at extra cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Adam Milne to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! That is very lucky for Bangladesh and Najmul Hossain Shanto. The captain living dangerously. Hits the hard length on the off-stump line and Najmul Hossain Shanto gets a hit on his glove that takes the ball just over the reach of the wicketkeeper and the ball races away to the third man boundary for four runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Adam Milne to Najmul Hossain Shanto, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched further up outside the off stump. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to cut it hard and gets an inside edge back to the wicket keeper on the bounce.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Adam Milne to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the length hard on the off stump line. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to run it down to third man but is beaten by the extra pace and bounce.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Adam Milne to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Shot of authority! On a length, outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto gives the charge and drills it aerially but to the left of mid off for a boundaty.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Adam Milne to Najmul Hossain Shanto, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on middle and leg, Litton Das pulls it without much timing but gets it past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Tim Southee to Litton Das, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, wide outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto throws his hands at the delivery and gets a thickish outside edge that goes on the bounce to third man for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Tim Southee to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! Angling into the pads, on a length, Litton Das misses the clip and gets hit on the thigh pad as the ball rolls to fine leg for a leg bye.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Tim Southee to Litton Das, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length and angling away, outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto works it with the angle as he glides it down to third man for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Tim Southee to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto waits on it and dabs it along the ground to backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Tim Southee to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Length delivery, on off, Litton Das watchfully tucks it with soft hands in front of mid-wicket and calls Najmul Hossain Shanto through for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Tim Southee to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Najmul Hossain Shanto gets off the mark in style! Milne bowls it short and outside off, Shanto gets this one at a good height and he does not miss out. He controls the pull well by rolling his wrists and hits it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Adam Milne to Najmul Hossain Shanto, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto gets on his toes and punches it to backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Adam Milne to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Najmul Hossain Shanto, the skipper of Bangladesh walks in to bat at number 3.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND GONE! Adam Milne strikes in his first over and gives New Zealand a much-needed early breakthrough! Rony Talukdar's ultra-attacking approach leads to his downfall! On a hard length, on off, Rony Talukdar tries to take it on off the front foot but does not manage to get on top of the bounce. Gets this one off the bottom part of the bat and skies it high in the air and only as far as mid on where Tim Southee snaffles it with his fingers pointing downwards.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim Southee b Adam Milne
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Adam Milne to Rony Talukdar, OUT! c Tim Southee b Adam Milne.

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off, Rony Talukdar stays deep in his crease and slogs it off the inner half of the bat to the right of mid on for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Adam Milne to Rony Talukdar, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! A bit too straight, straying down leg, on a back of a length, Rony Talukdar misses the tickle and the umpire calls it a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Adam Milne to Rony Talukdar, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Excellent stop! Adam Milne hurls it on a length, on off, Rony Talukdar clears his front leg and hammers it down the ground towards mid off. Mitchell Santner reacts quickly and dives to his right to make a half-stop. Two runs taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Adam Milne to Rony Talukdar, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it with an upright seam, on off, on a length, Litton Das walks across to scoop it over short fine leg. Gets an inside edge on the front pad as the ball rolls on the leg side for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Adam Milne to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Adam Milne to bowl the second over for New Zealand.
Bowls it in the channel on off, outside off, Rony Talukdar looks to play at this one away from his body and gets beaten as the ball zips past the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Tim Southee to Rony Talukdar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Whoa...what a shot to get off the mark! Tim Southee serves it on a length, on off, Rony Talukdar backs away and creates room. He takes no half-measures as he tonks the ball over the cover fence for his first maximum.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Tim Southee to Rony Talukdar, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Pulls his length back and bowls it around off, Rony Talukdar waits back in his crease and dabs it along the ground towards backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Tim Southee to Rony Talukdar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Angles it into the right-hander, on a length, on middle, Rony Talukdar clips it neatly but can't get it past Mark Chapman at mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Tim Southee to Rony Talukdar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Litton Das and Bangladesh are underway! Bowls it on the fifth stump line, on a good length, a hint of away movement, Litton Das gets forward and taps it in front of mid off for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Tim Southee to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Starts from over the wicket and strays on the pads, on a length, Litton Das gets half-forward and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Tim Southee to Litton Das, No run.
